facts.fact: A vendor case study says Ethiopia's National Open Data Exchange platform, run by the Ministry of Innovation and Technology, offers bulk dataset downloads and serves city administrations in Dire Dawa, Bahir Dar and Adama.
The Ministry of Agriculture's National Agri Data Hub lists 1,910 datasets in RDF and JSON-LD formats, with no data licence stated.

The Ministry of Agriculture's data hub lists datasets published by two public bodies, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research, besides one international centre (Alliance Bioversity and CIAT).
